name: pocabinet-tools
description: Node tools for PoCabinet assets and checks (ksplat.mjs packs the court scan's Gaussian splat, court-pack.mjs repacks its mesh with KTX2 textures and Meshopt, radio-voices.mjs voices the officials' radio lines, debris-check.mjs drops debris on the circuit through the Rapier solver). Not part of the app build.
